response.sql:
WITH team_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    team_id,
    AVG(w) as avg_wins,
    AVG(CASE WHEN l IS NOT NULL AND l > 0 AND g IS NOT NULL 
             THEN (g - l) / CAST(l AS NUMERIC) 
             ELSE NULL END) as avg_win_ratio
  FROM manager_half
  WHERE team_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY team_id
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as mean_wins
  FROM team_stats
)
SELECT 
  ts.team_id,
  ts.avg_wins,
  ts.avg_win_ratio,
  ts.avg_wins - om.mean_wins as gap
FROM team_stats ts
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE ts.avg_wins > om.mean_wins
ORDER BY gap DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: "The mean across teams" refers to AVG(team average wins)—i.e., the average of team-level average wins—rather than the overall average of all w values in manager_half.
"Average wins" is a simple arithmetic mean of w values per team, not weighted by games or other factors.

alternatives.interpretation: "The mean across teams" refers to the global average of all w values in manager_half, unweighted by team. This would weight the mean by the number of records per team.
